dialogues.jp: は〜、やっと終わった。
dialogues.en: Haah, finally over.
dialogues.text: Haah, finally over.

dialogues.jp: 土曜日の授業って、どうしてこんなに眠いんだ。
dialogues.en: Saturday classes are always the worst.
dialogues.text: Saturday classes are always the worst.

dialogues.jp:
半日だから、精神的には楽なはずなのに、やは
り疲れる。
dialogues.en:
Even if it's only a half day, the stress and exertions of
the week start to take it's toll.
dialogues.text:
Even if it's only a half day, the stress and exertions of
the week start to take it's toll.

dialogues.jp: さっさと帰って、テレビでも見るか。
dialogues.en:
Time to flop onto the sofa and commence vegetation in front
of the television.
dialogues.text:
Time to flop onto the sofa and commence vegetation in front
of the television.

dialogues.jp: 明日は、環とデートだし。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and I will be going on a date tomorrow.
dialogues.text: Tamaki and I will be going on a date tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: 別に準備することもないけど……。
dialogues.en: Although we didn't have any special plans...
dialogues.text: Although we didn't have any special plans...

dialogues.jp: 俺は荷物を鞄にまとめる。
dialogues.en: I started packing stuff into my bag.
dialogues.text: I started packing stuff into my bag.

dialogues.jp: すると、杉並が寄ってくる。
dialogues.en: Suginami suddenly appeared in front of my desk.
dialogues.text: Suginami suddenly appeared in front of my desk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よお、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: いつになく、俺を呼ぶ杉並の声が弾んでいる。
dialogues.en: His voice was like a bullet piercing through the night.
dialogues.text: His voice was like a bullet piercing through the night.

dialogues.jp: 何かあったのか……？
dialogues.en: Did something happen...?
dialogues.text: Did something happen...?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「この世には、人には計り知れない不思議なこ
　とがある」
dialogues.en: "This world is truly full of unexplainable mysteries."
dialogues.text: "This world is truly full of unexplainable mysteries."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 何だよいきなり。
dialogues.en: What's with that, all of a sudden?
dialogues.text: What's with that, all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「エジプトのピラミッド、イースター島のモア
　イ……これらを取ってみても、科学では解明
　しきれない謎がある」
dialogues.en:
"The pyramids of Egypt, the Moai Easter Island heads... all
unexplainable, by science or other means."
dialogues.text:
"The pyramids of Egypt, the Moai Easter Island heads... all
unexplainable, by science or other means."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Uh, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, yeah..."

dialogues.jp: どうしたんだ？
dialogues.en: Something's happened.
dialogues.text: Something's happened.

dialogues.jp:
いつものことと言えば、いつものことなのだが、
杉並のミステリーウンチクが始まっている。
dialogues.en: He wouldn't start on his mystery craze just randomly.
dialogues.text: He wouldn't start on his mystery craze just randomly.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そして、今日また、ここに一つの謎が……」
dialogues.en:
"And today, yet another phenomenon can be added to that
list..."
dialogues.text:
"And today, yet another phenomenon can be added to that
list..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……で、何なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...What happened."
dialogues.text: "...What happened."

dialogues.jp:
突っ込みを入れないと、永久にウンチクが続き
そうなので、尋ねてみる。
dialogues.en:
If I didn't cut to the chase now, he could go on forever on
this subject.
dialogues.text:
If I didn't cut to the chase now, he could go on forever on
this subject.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「また一つ、学園の七不思議に加えられるであ
　ろう」
dialogues.en:
"Yet another mystery to be added to the school's Seven Great
Wonders."
dialogues.text:
"Yet another mystery to be added to the school's Seven Great
Wonders."

dialogues.jp:
だから、何だよ……。加えたら、七不思議じゃ
なくなってしまうだろ。
dialogues.en:
Sheesh, spit it out already... although, uh, it won't be
seven anymore...
dialogues.text:
Sheesh, spit it out already... although, uh, it won't be
seven anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「野球部が、１回戦を突破した」
dialogues.en: "The baseball club finally won a game."
dialogues.text: "The baseball club finally won a game."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp:
前置きが長かった割には、そんなにたいしたこ
と無いような……。
dialogues.en:
With that long and drawn-out backstory, I was expecting
something a lot more grand...
dialogues.text:
With that long and drawn-out backstory, I was expecting
something a lot more grand...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それは９回裏……２−０で相手チームが有利
　だった。このまま一人抑えれば、確実に勝ち
　が待っていた、しかし！」
dialogues.en:
"Bottom of the 9th, 2 outs... the opposing team was leading
2-0. The end result seemed obvious. However!"
dialogues.text:
"Bottom of the 9th, 2 outs... the opposing team was leading
2-0. The end result seemed obvious. However!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「しかし？」
dialogues.en: "However?"
dialogues.text: "However?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ピッチャーが投げ、打ったボールは、どう見
　ても冴えない平凡なセンターフライ。しかし
　そのとき突風が！」
dialogues.en:
"The batter popped out a seemingly standard center fly. Then
suddenly! A strong gust of wind!"
dialogues.text:
"The batter popped out a seemingly standard center fly. Then
suddenly! A strong gust of wind!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は思わず杉並の話に引き込まれ、唾を飲み込
む。
dialogues.en:
Listening to Suginami's story, I unconciously swallowed
hard.
dialogues.text:
Listening to Suginami's story, I unconciously swallowed
hard.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「その突風は、ボールを運び、何と場外ホーム
　ラン！　我が野球部はサヨナラ勝ちだ」
dialogues.en:
"The wind carried the ball past the fence for a home run!
Our baseball club's farewell victory!"
dialogues.text:
"The wind carried the ball past the fence for a home run!
Our baseball club's farewell victory!"

dialogues.jp: って、ことは……。
dialogues.en: Then, that means...
dialogues.text: Then, that means...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前のワイフはすごい！」
dialogues.en: "Your wife is amazing!"
dialogues.text: "Your wife is amazing!"

dialogues.jp: ワイフ……杉並の発言がオヤジ化してる。
dialogues.en: Wife... what the hell.
dialogues.text: Wife... what the hell.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「信じられん！　この世にやはり超能力はある
　のだ！」
dialogues.en:
"It's unbelievable! There are truly beings of a higher power
on this earth!"
dialogues.text:
"It's unbelievable! There are truly beings of a higher power
on this earth!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あの野球部が、奇跡の初戦突破とは！」
dialogues.en:
"Beings who can make our baseball club get their first win!
Beings who create miracles!"
dialogues.text:
"Beings who can make our baseball club get their first win!
Beings who create miracles!"

dialogues.jp: 万年、初戦敗退の野球部。
dialogues.en:
The baseball club, who had never won a game since it's
creation.
dialogues.text:
The baseball club, who had never won a game since it's
creation.

dialogues.jp: 環の必勝祈願がきいたのか……。
dialogues.en: Once Tamaki performed a victory prayer for them...
dialogues.text: Once Tamaki performed a victory prayer for them...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮嬢はすごい！　多分予知能力の他にも、
　何か眠っているに違いない……」
dialogues.en:
"Konomiya is amazing! There must be latent powers hiding
inside her, besides her clairvoyance..."
dialogues.text:
"Konomiya is amazing! There must be latent powers hiding
inside her, besides her clairvoyance..."

dialogues.jp: 杉並はいつになく興奮している。
dialogues.en: Unsurprisingly, Suginami's interest was peaked.
dialogues.text: Unsurprisingly, Suginami's interest was peaked.

dialogues.jp: よかった。
dialogues.en: That's good, though.
dialogues.text: That's good, though.

dialogues.jp: 環が聞いたら、ほっとするだろう。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure that's what Tamaki'd say as well, when she hears
the news.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure that's what Tamaki'd say as well, when she hears
the news.

dialogues.jp: これで、一勝できた野球部も、満足だろう。
dialogues.en:
There's a sense of satisfaction in helping someone achieve
something they've never done before.
dialogues.text:
There's a sense of satisfaction in helping someone achieve
something they've never done before.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、環の能力はすごいのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
And maybe her powers are really more spectacular than I ever
imagined...
dialogues.text:
And maybe her powers are really more spectacular than I ever
imagined...

dialogues.jp: 後で、教えてあげよう。
dialogues.en: I'd have to ask her later.
dialogues.text: I'd have to ask her later.

dialogues.jp: ◆必勝祈願が効いた！◆
dialogues.en: ◆Successful Victory Prayer!?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Successful Victory Prayer!?◆

dialogues.jp: 杉並が、すごいニュースを運んできた。
dialogues.en: Suginami delivered amazing news right to my desk.
dialogues.text: Suginami delivered amazing news right to my desk.

dialogues.jp: あの万年弱小野球部が逆転勝利したというのだ！
dialogues.en:
The weak baseball club who had never won a game, pulled out
a comeback victory.
dialogues.text:
The weak baseball club who had never won a game, pulled out
a comeback victory.

dialogues.jp: まさか、環の必勝祈願が効いたのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
It could well have been the effect of Tamaki's victory
prayer.
dialogues.text:
It could well have been the effect of Tamaki's victory
prayer.

dialogues.jp:
もしかして、環には、予知能力以外にも、いろ
んな能力が隠されているのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps, besides clairvoyance, there's other latent powers
within Tamaki...
dialogues.text:
Perhaps, besides clairvoyance, there's other latent powers
within Tamaki...
